body: A locked safe with no known combination, a heavy unit that needs to move across the building, or an outdated code that too many people know, these are the kinds of problems that bring customers to us. Be Secure Locksmith provides mobile safe services throughout North Central Florida, arriving at your home or business with the tools and experience to handle each situation correctly without damaging the safe or its contents.
What Does a Safe Locksmith Actually Do?
Safe locksmith work covers several distinct services, each requiring a different approach and set of tools. Common services we provide include:

• Opening locked or malfunctioning safes
  • Combination changes on mechanical and electronic safes
  • Dial servicing and lock mechanism evaluation
  • Safe relocation coordination and anchor installation

We work with combination dial safes, digital keypad safes, and key-operated models. Knowing which method applies to your unit saves time and prevents unnecessary damage. Our techs bring the right equipment for each job so you're not waiting on a second visit.
Can a Locksmith Open a Safe Without the Combination?

Yes, and it's one of the most frequent reasons people call us. Forgotten combinations, malfunctioning electronic keypads, and damaged dials can all prevent access to a safe that's otherwise in perfect condition. A locksmith trained in safe work can often open the unit non-destructively through manipulation or bypassing techniques specific to that lock type. If non-damaging entry isn't possible, drilling is sometimes necessary, and our techs always discuss the tradeoffs with you before moving forward with any method that affects the safe itself.

One situation we see regularly involves customers who've purchased a property in the Gainesville or Ocala area and found a safe left behind by the previous owner, with no combination and no documentation. That's a straightforward job for a safe locksmith. Our safe locksmith service page has more detail on what to expect during the opening process and how we protect your property along the way.
Changing a Safe Combination: When and Why It Matters
Changing your safe's combination is a smart step any time access may have been shared or compromised. Consider a combination change if any of the following apply:

• Your business has had recent employee turnover
  • Your household has changed occupants
  • You're unsure how many people know the current code
  • You've recently purchased a used safe

For electronic keypad safes, owners can often make this change using the manufacturer's instructions. When the safe uses a mechanical dial, the process requires disassembly of the lock and precise alignment of internal components. Attempting this without the right tools can result in a lockout or a damaged mechanism. Our lock rekeying service reflects the same careful approach we bring to safe combination work.
Moving a Safe: What a Locksmith Can Help With

Safes are built to be heavy and difficult to move on purpose, and improper handling can damage flooring, the unit itself, or result in injury. We can advise on the right approach based on the safe's size and weight, and coordinate with moving teams to ensure the lock mechanism isn't compromised in transit.

If the safe needs to be bolted down at its new location, we can assist with that too. Anchoring a safe properly makes it significantly harder to remove during a break-in. Our residential locksmith services extend to exactly this kind of protective work for homeowners throughout the area.
Safe Services for Businesses in Gainesville and Ocala

Businesses that handle cash, sensitive documents, or high-value inventory rely on safes as a core part of their security setup. When a safe malfunctions or needs to be moved during a renovation, the disruption affects daily operations. We respond to commercial safe calls with the same mobile, on-site approach we use for all business locksmith work. No need to transport the safe to a shop.

Combination changes are especially relevant when staff changes occur. If someone who had safe access is no longer with the business, updating the combination is a basic step that's easy to defer but important not to skip. Our commercial locksmith services cover this type of access control update alongside broader security work. For businesses managing multiple locations, pairing safe servicing with a master key system can simplify access management considerably.
